title: compile-check
summary: Runs a compiler-backed check against a single Delphi project (.dproj) or source file (.pas) and reports the result
intro: Read this when you want a compiler-backed check of one project or one source file without a full build. compile-check takes a .dproj or .pas target and reports the result as text or json.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint compile-check <target.dproj|.pas> [--project <X.dproj>] [--db PATH] [--format json|text] (no --db: caches only into the project's unique manifest owner, else reports uncached; no index is required, the compile and report still run; exit 1 iff an Error finding)
help: drag-lint compile-check <target.dproj|.pas> [--project <X.dproj>] [--db PATH] [--format json|text]   (no --db: caches only into the project's unique manifest owner, else reports uncached; no index is required, the compile and report still run; exit 1 iff an Error finding)

questions.ask: Does this project or unit compile, without a full build?
Can I get the compile result as JSON?

notes: issued by the plugin from RunCompileDiagnoseAsync (DragLint.Plugin.Editor.pas)
